scope: Training-only language-conditioning prior; existing exposed development images, no fresh candidate access
hypothesis: A conditional generative distribution over continuous prefixes can preserve coherent alternatives better than pointwise mean regression
text_features: Pinned frozen EmbeddingGemma2, no vision/audio towers, official Document task format, normalized 768D; training and separate diagnostic controls only
corpus: Deterministically authored Italian scene clauses combined with varied independent continuations; no single shared ending; exact duplicates removed
split: Hold out clause/continuation combinations before fitting, all words may occur in training; max1280 train/160 held; source categories balanced
targets: Pinned frozen Qwen projected text vectors, up to32 positions; PAD to32 plus joint continuous length scalar
reader: Conditional continuous rectified-flow MLP, width256, under25M trainable parameters, no text vocabulary or runtime target lookup
objective: Mean continuous velocity MSE plus joint normalized-length velocity MSE
flow_inference: 64 fixed Euler steps, conditional vector, fixed Gaussian seed42; no category classifier or stored prefix retrieval
evaluation: Prespecified text-feature training/held diagnostic controls, existing four development images and null; real Qwen sampled audio seed42 cap105
acceptance: Tensor diagnostics and auxiliary ASR are not acceptance. Human listening and later separate fresh/shuffled image evaluation required
resources: Existing local single worker, frozen backbones, no paid jobs or publication of private artifacts
